svg.text: Native single-clock generator | loaded schematic inspection
10 MHz; 298.15 K model trial; source words A..F: 769, 819, 898, 819, 819, 807
Native Spectre PortBench recipes are authoritative. This drawing has the same DUT, source levels, timing, real decoupler and output loads.
Six ten-bit words; bit 8 is strapped to VDD in the measured native fixture.
Open XDUT to inspect the direct six-section signal path; open its blocks to inspect transistor-level circuits.
The six slow bypasses are physical VDD straps. Other static bits are supplied by the declared native drives or direct rail connections.
All source work is included in native energy accounting. No additional normal-operation clock or bias-current input is required.
